# Fixture provenance — Geant4 detector outputs (Track3P plan Phase 4)

Frozen 2026-10-06 for Phase 4 step 1 of `plans/track3p_module_plan.md`.

Both files are **verbatim copies** of real output from Lixin Ge's LCLS-II
polycone Geant4 application — the `detectors = on` scoring the repo's
`geant4` module learned to read in this phase. Neither is truncated or
edited; they are small because the run was.

**Source root:**
`/sdf/group/rfar/geant4/example/ace3p-geant4-workflow-LCLS-polycone/convergence/polycone/pass100/`
— the 100-pass point of Lixin's `G4Tubs` vs `G4Polycone` convergence study
(package handoff 2026-09-10, see `README.md` §8 there). Outside this repo and
not version-controlled, which is why these are copied in rather than read at
test time.

Nothing under `tests/fixtures/` is generated by the test suite. To refresh
these, re-copy from the package and update this file.

---

## Contents

| File | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `detector_dose.csv` | `c3_16MV_beta120_polycone_p100_merged_detector_dose.csv` | 8 rows, one per GM-tube detector. |
| `detector_gamma_spectrum.csv` | `c3_16MV_beta120_polycone_p100_merged_detector_gamma_spectrum.csv` | 52 rows; ragged across detectors (5, 15, 8, 8, 7, 4, 1, 4 rows for detectors 1–8). |

Both carry a `#`-commented header and are **comma**-separated, which is why
they need their own readers rather than `ace3p.parse_column_file` (that one
splits on whitespace and returns a single garbage key for these).

## The run behind them

C3 solo mode at 16 MV/m, β = 120, 100 passes over 182 405 macro-particles, one
part on one Milano node, `seed = 20260926`. Its full input file is
`input_part1.txt` beside the source; the geometry keys that matter for these
outputs are `cavity_stl = nb_wall_profile.dat`, `cryostat = on`,
`detectors = on`, `detector_r = 1000.0`, `detector_size = 12.5`,
`detector_angle = 0.0`.

The 8 detector Z positions (414, 1801, 3189, 4576, 5963, 7351, 8738,
10126 mm) are **compiled into the application**, not configurable —
`construction.hh:42` — so they are a property of the LCLS-II cryomodule
geometry, one detector per cavity centre.

## Two things worth knowing before asserting on them

- **Seven of the eight `edep_MeV` values are exactly zero**, and that is a
  real result rather than a missing one: only detector 5 (z = 5963 mm) saw
  energy deposited in this run, while all eight counted gamma entries. A
  reader that treats 0 as "absent" would be wrong here, which is why the tests
  pin the zeros explicitly.
- **`_merged_` vs `_part1_`.** These copies are the `_merged_` files, written
  by the package's `scripts/merge_parts.py`, which sums the parts of a split
  run — here a sum over a single part, so the numbers are the part's own. The
  `_part1_` siblings hold the same values in `%g` (`0`, `2.01079e+07`) where
  the merged files use fixed notation (`0.0`, `20107900.0`). Either parses
  identically; the merged form was taken because it is what a finished
  multi-node run leaves behind and so what a user would point the module at.
